annotation.title_clean: Proposal for a Regulation amending Regulations (EU) 2017/745 and (EU) 2017/746 as regards simplifying and reducing the burden of the rules on medical devices and in vitro diagnostic medical devices, and amending Regulations (EU) 2022/123 and (EU) 2024/1689
annotation.title_en: Proposal for a Regulation amending Regulations (EU) 2017/745 and (EU) 2017/746 as regards simplifying and reducing the burden of the rules on medical devices and in vitro diagnostic medical devices, and amending Regulations (EU) 2022/123 and (EU) 2024/1689
annotation.summary_en: European Commission proposal (December 2025) to simplify the Medical Devices and IVD Regulations, reduce burden, streamline notified body oversight, add regulatory sandboxes and cybersecurity reporting, and move MDR/IVDR from Section A to Section B of AI Act Annex I to limit overlap with high-risk AI requirements.
key_provisions_or_claims: Moves MDR and IVDR from Annex I Section A to Section B of the AI Act, limiting AI Act application to AI-enabled devices.
Commission must take AI Act Chapter III Section 2 requirements into account when adopting acts for high-risk AI medical devices.
Notified bodies assessing high-risk AI devices must meet AI Act Article 31 requirements.
Introduces national and Union regulatory sandboxes for innovative devices.
New cybersecurity reporting of exploited vulnerabilities and severe incidents to CSIRTs and ENISA via Eudamed.
